title: Refund processing time
body: Approved refunds complete in 5-7 business days from the date of approval.

title: Refund delayed past 10 business days
body: A refund still pending after 10 business days must be escalated to the billing team with the order ID.

title: Refund goes to the original payment method
body: Refunds return to the card or account used at purchase. We cannot redirect a refund to a different card.

title: Refund to a closed or expired card
body: The bank routes the refund to the replacement card automatically. If the account is closed the customer must contact their bank; this adds 7-10 days.

title: Partial refund on a multi-item order
body: Each returned item is refunded separately. Shipping is refunded only when the entire order is returned.

title: Refund versus store credit
body: The customer chooses. Store credit is issued instantly; a card refund takes 5-7 business days.

title: Refund not visible on the bank statement
body: A sent refund can take up to 3 further business days to appear on the customer's statement.

title: Is shipping cost refundable
body: Shipping is refunded only when the order arrived damaged, was the wrong item, or was cancelled before dispatch.

title: Refund after using a discount code
body: We refund the amount actually paid after the discount, not the list price.

title: Refund on a gift order
body: The refund returns to the original purchaser's payment method, not the recipient.

title: Cancel an order before it ships
body: An order cancelled before dispatch is refunded in full with no fee.

title: Restocking fees
body: We charge no restocking fee on standard returns. Opened software and consumables are excluded from return.

title: Refund for a subscription
body: Subscription refunds are prorated from the cancellation date to the end of the paid period.

title: Duplicate charge refund
body: A confirmed duplicate charge is refunded within 3 business days.

title: Refund requested outside the return window
body: The standard return window is 30 days; clearance items are 14 days. Late requests are reviewed case by case.

title: International refund currency differences
body: Refunds are issued in the original currency. Any difference in the amount received is the bank's exchange rate.

title: Refund when a chargeback is open
body: We cannot refund and settle a chargeback at the same time. Once a bank dispute is open it takes precedence.

title: Refund confirmation receipt
body: A confirmation email is sent when the refund is issued and can be resent on request.

title: Refund to PayPal
body: PayPal refunds appear in 3-5 business days.

title: Refund for a price drop after purchase
body: We price match within 14 days of purchase and refund the difference.

title: Refund when the item never arrived
body: Once the carrier confirms the parcel is lost we issue a full refund or send a replacement, customer's choice.

title: Refund for a cancelled pre-order
body: A cancelled pre-order is refunded automatically within 5 business days.

title: Return shipping deducted from a refund
body: Return shipping is deducted only on change-of-mind returns, never on faulty or wrong items.

title: Refund on part of a bundle
body: Returning part of a bundle recalculates the bundle discount on the items kept.

title: Escalating a refund complaint
body: Escalate to the billing team quoting the order ID. They respond within 1 business day.

title: Standard versus express delivery times
body: Standard shipping takes 3-5 business days; express takes 1-2.

title: Where is my tracking number
body: Tracking is emailed automatically when the order ships. Ask the customer to check spam.

title: Tracking has not updated
body: Carriers can go 24-48 hours without a scan, especially in transit between hubs. This does not mean the parcel is lost.

title: Marked delivered but nothing arrived
body: Ask the customer to check with neighbours and any safe place, then report within 7 days so we can open a carrier investigation.

title: Change the delivery address after ordering
body: The address can only be changed before the order is dispatched.

title: Delivery to a PO box
body: PO boxes are supported on standard shipping only, not express.

title: International shipping times
body: International orders take 7-21 business days depending on customs clearance.

title: Customs duties and import tax
body: Import duties and taxes are paid by the recipient and are not included in our prices.

title: Order arriving in multiple parcels
body: Multi-item orders may ship in separate parcels at no extra cost. Each parcel has its own tracking.

title: Weekend delivery
body: Saturday delivery is available on express only. There is no Sunday delivery.

title: Missed delivery attempt
body: The carrier retries twice, then holds the parcel at the local depot for 5 days.

title: Delivery instructions and safe place
body: Instructions can be added any time before dispatch and are passed to the carrier.

title: Shipping to a different country than billing
body: Allowed, though address verification may be requested for higher-value orders.

title: Free shipping threshold
body: Orders over the stated value ship free on standard delivery. Express is always charged.

title: Upgrade shipping on an existing order
body: Shipping can only be upgraded before dispatch, and the price difference is charged.

title: Order held in customs
body: Customs holds usually clear within 5 business days. We can supply commercial invoices if requested.

title: Parcel visibly damaged at the door
body: The customer may refuse delivery. If accepted, report the damage the same day for a carrier claim.

title: Signature required on delivery
body: A signature is required on orders above a set value and cannot be waived.

title: Delivery to a locker or pickup point
body: Supported in selected regions and shown at checkout when available.

title: Peak season delivery delays
body: Add 2-3 business days to all estimates between November and December.

title: Customer entered the wrong address
body: We can attempt to recall the parcel only before dispatch. After that the parcel must complete delivery and be returned.

title: Tracking shows returned to sender
body: Usually caused by a failed delivery or bad address. We reship or refund once the parcel is back.

title: Several tracking numbers for one order
body: Split shipments generate one tracking number per parcel. All are listed in the account.

title: Is shipping insured
body: All orders are insured in transit at no extra cost.

title: Estimated delivery date moved
body: Delivery dates are carrier estimates, not guarantees, and can shift with weather or volume.

title: Order has not arrived by the estimated date
body: Check tracking first. If there has been no carrier scan for 48 hours we open an investigation and reship or refund.

title: How to check the status of an order
body: Order status and live tracking are shown on the order page in the customer's account.

title: Package delayed in transit
body: Transit delays are usually weather or carrier volume. If a parcel has not moved for 7 days we reship or refund.

title: Parcel left with a neighbour
body: Carriers may leave a parcel with a neighbour and note it on the tracking. The card or tracking entry says which address.

title: Item arrived damaged
body: Offer a replacement or a full refund. Request a photo only if a carrier claim is needed; never require one before helping.

title: Screen cracked on arrival
body: Treat as damage on arrival: replacement dispatched immediately, no photo needed to start the process.

title: Box crushed but the item works
body: Log the report for the carrier record even when the item is fine, so packaging issues are tracked.

title: Parts missing from the box
body: Send the missing part on its own, or replace the whole unit if the part is not stocked separately.

title: Wrong item received
body: Issue a free return label and dispatch the correct item without waiting for the return.

title: Item damaged on the return journey
body: If our return label was used, transit damage is our responsibility, not the customer's.

title: Photo requirements for a damage claim
body: When a carrier claim is required we need one clear photo of the item and one of the outer packaging.

title: Time limit to report damage
body: Damage must be reported within 7 days of delivery.

title: How fast a replacement ships
body: Approved replacements dispatch within 1 business day.

title: Must the damaged item come back first
body: No. The replacement ships immediately and the return label is sent alongside it.

title: Only the accessory is damaged
body: Ship the accessory on its own; the main unit does not need to be returned.

title: Item damaged after use
body: Damage discovered after use is handled under warranty, not as damage on arrival.

title: Liquid damage
body: Liquid damage is not covered by the standard warranty and is chargeable to repair.

title: Damaged item that was a gift
body: We can send the replacement directly to the recipient without notifying the purchaser if asked.

title: Repeated damaged deliveries to one address
body: Escalate for a packaging review and request a carrier change for that route.

title: Damaged clearance item
body: Clearance items carry the same damage-on-arrival protection as full-price stock.

title: One damaged item in a multi-item order
body: Only the damaged line is replaced; the rest of the order is unaffected.

title: What to do with the damaged item
body: The customer may keep or dispose of it unless we specifically request its return.

title: Device will not power on
body: Hold the power button 30 seconds, try a different charger and outlet. If there is still no response, route to technical support for a diagnostic.

title: What the warranty covers
body: The warranty covers manufacturing defects for 12 months from delivery.

title: Nothing on screen after an update
body: Force restart first. If the screen stays blank, route to technical support as a possible failed firmware update.

title: Battery drains very quickly
body: Run a diagnostic. Battery health below 80% within the warranty period is covered by replacement.

title: Device overheating
body: Check ventilation and background load first. Persistent overheating at idle needs a hardware check.

title: Will not connect to WiFi
body: Forget and rejoin the network, restart the router, and confirm the network adapter driver is current.

title: Bluetooth will not pair
body: Clear the paired device list and reset the Bluetooth module, then pair again.

title: Device running slowly
body: Check free storage and background processes. If performance is still poor after cleanup, run a diagnostic.

title: Firmware or driver update failed
body: Reinstall through recovery mode. Do not interrupt power during the update.

title: Keyboard keys not responding
body: Test with an external keyboard. If the external one works the fault is the built-in keyboard hardware.

title: Touchpad unresponsive
body: Check the function-key lock first, which disables the touchpad and is the most common cause.

title: Screen flickering
body: Update the display driver first. If flickering persists it points to the panel or its cable.

title: No sound from the device
body: Confirm the correct output device is selected and the system is not muted before treating it as hardware.

title: USB ports not recognising devices
body: Test another device and another cable to isolate the port from the peripheral.

title: Loud fan noise
body: Fan noise under heavy load is normal. A grinding or rattling noise indicates a hardware fault.

title: Blue screen or kernel panic
body: Capture the exact error code shown and provide it to technical support; it identifies the failing component.

title: Backing up data before a repair
body: Data backup is the customer's responsibility. We cannot guarantee data survives a repair.

title: Repair turnaround time
body: Repairs take 5-7 business days in the workshop plus shipping each way.

title: Loaner device during repair
body: We do not offer loaner or replacement devices while a repair is in progress.

title: Out-of-warranty repair cost
body: Out-of-warranty repairs are quoted before any work begins and the customer can decline.

title: Accidental damage cover
body: Accidental damage is not covered by the standard warranty.

title: Third-party repair and the warranty
body: Repair by an unauthorised provider voids the remaining warranty.

title: Software problems versus hardware
body: Software support is best-effort. Operating system faults are referred to the OS vendor.

title: Remote diagnostic
body: A remote diagnostic can be run with the customer's explicit consent and takes about 15 minutes.

title: Escalating a technical case
body: Route to technical support with the diagnostic reference number attached.

title: Password reset email never arrives
body: Check spam and whitelist our domain. A resend can be triggered after 15 minutes.

title: Verify identity before an account change
body: Verify identity before any account change. Never ask the customer for their full password.

title: Account locked after failed sign-in attempts
body: The account unlocks automatically after 30 minutes. It can be unlocked sooner after identity verification.

title: Change the email address on an account
body: A verification link is sent to both the old and the new address before the change takes effect.

title: Setting up two-factor authentication
body: Two-factor is available by authenticator app or SMS and is configured in account security settings.

title: Lost the two-factor device
body: Use a saved recovery code. Without one, full identity verification is required to reset two-factor.

title: Delete my account
body: Deletion requests are processed within 30 days, subject to legal retention on order records.

title: Merge duplicate accounts
body: Duplicate accounts can be merged and order history is combined into the surviving account.

title: Change the name on an account
body: Name changes are supported after identity verification.

title: Someone else accessed my account
body: Lock the account immediately, force a password reset, and review recent orders for unauthorised activity.

title: Update the payment method on file
body: Payment methods are updated in account settings only. Never collect card details over email or chat.

title: Unsubscribe from marketing email
body: Use the unsubscribe link in the email footer. Changes take up to 48 hours.

title: Order history is missing
body: Almost always a second account under a different email. Search by order number to confirm.

title: Business or company account
body: Business accounts are supported and require tax registration details.

title: Typo in the email address at signup
body: Correcting a signup email requires identity verification because the address cannot be confirmed.

title: Session keeps expiring
body: Clear cookies and confirm the device clock is correct; a wrong system time breaks session tokens.

title: Correct password but cannot sign in
body: Check caps lock, whether the account is locked, and that the customer is on the correct regional site.

title: Linking a guest checkout order to an account
body: A guest order can be linked later using the order number and the email used at checkout.

title: We never ask for a full password
body: Agents must never request a full password. Tell customers that any such request is fraudulent.

title: Sharing one account between people
body: The terms allow one person per account. Business accounts support multiple named users.

title: Standard return window
body: Returns are accepted within 30 days of delivery for any reason.

title: How to start a return
body: The customer requests a return in their account or through support, and a prepaid label is issued.

title: Who pays return shipping
body: Return shipping is free for faulty or wrong items. Change-of-mind returns are paid by the customer.

title: Exchange for a different model
body: Process as a return plus a new order; the price difference is charged or refunded.

title: Return without the original packaging
body: Accepted as long as the item is adequately protected for transit.

title: Returning an opened item
body: Opened items are accepted unless a hygiene seal or software seal has been broken.

title: Clearance item returns
body: Clearance stock has a 14-day return window rather than 30.

title: Returning a gift
body: The recipient can return for store credit, or the original purchaser can request a refund.

title: Where to send a return
body: Only to the address on the issued return label. Returns sent elsewhere cannot be tracked or refunded.

title: Return received but no refund yet
body: Allow 3 business days after the warehouse receives the return before escalating.

title: Tracking a return
body: Return tracking is included with the issued label and visible in the account.

title: Refusing delivery as a return
body: Refused deliveries are accepted as returns and treated as change-of-mind unless the parcel was damaged.

title: Exchange item is out of stock
body: Offer a refund or a backorder; do not hold the return unresolved.

title: Returning part of a bundle
body: Bundle pricing is recalculated on the items the customer keeps.

title: Returning a promotional purchase
body: Refunded at the price actually paid during the promotion, not the full price.

title: Items that cannot be returned
body: Perishables, personalised items and opened software cannot be returned.

title: Returning from another country
body: International returns are supported; the customer pays shipping unless the item is faulty.

title: Return requested after the window closed
body: Reviewed case by case. Store credit is often offered where a refund is not.

title: Accepted payment methods
body: We accept major credit and debit cards, PayPal, and bank transfer for business accounts.

title: Card was declined
body: Declines are decided by the issuing bank. Ask the customer to verify details and available funds.

title: Pending charge with no matching order
body: This is a pre-authorisation hold and drops off within 3-5 business days.

title: Charged twice for one order
body: One entry is usually a pre-authorisation. Confirm both settled before refunding the duplicate.

title: Invoice or VAT receipt
body: Invoices are downloadable from the order page in the customer's account.

title: Change the billing address
body: Billing addresses are updated in account settings and apply to future orders.

title: Paying in instalments
body: Instalment plans are offered in selected regions and shown at checkout when eligible.

title: Which currency am I charged in
body: Orders are charged in the store currency; the bank applies its own exchange rate.

title: Foreign transaction fee
body: Foreign transaction fees are charged by the customer's bank, not by us.

title: Purchase orders and net terms
body: Purchase orders and net payment terms are available to approved business accounts only.

title: Charge shows an unfamiliar name
body: The bank descriptor differs from the brand name. Give the customer the exact descriptor to match.

title: When does my subscription renew
body: The renewal date is shown in the account. Cancel before that date to avoid the next charge.

title: Cancel a subscription
body: Cancellation takes effect at the end of the paid period, with a prorated refund where applicable.

title: Subscription payment failed
body: We retry the payment three times over 7 days before suspending the subscription.

title: Update the card on file
body: Cards on file are updated in account settings. Agents must never take card numbers directly.

title: Promo code will not apply
body: Check eligibility, expiry, and that no other code is in use; only one code per order is allowed.

title: Price changed after I ordered
body: The customer is charged the price shown at the time the order was placed.

title: Tax exemption
body: A valid exemption certificate is required and applies to future orders, not retrospectively.

title: How long is the warranty
body: The standard warranty is 12 months from the delivery date.

title: What the warranty covers
body: Manufacturing defects in materials and workmanship under normal use.

title: What the warranty excludes
body: Accidental damage, liquid damage, normal wear, and unauthorised repair are all excluded.

title: Proof of purchase for a claim
body: The order number is sufficient proof; no paper receipt is needed.

title: Warranty on a replacement unit
body: A replacement carries the remainder of the original warranty or 90 days, whichever is longer.

title: Extended warranty
body: Extended cover can be purchased at the time of the original order only.

title: Transferring a warranty to a new owner
body: Warranty follows the product and transfers with proof of the original purchase.

title: International warranty cover
body: Warranty is honoured in the region where the product was purchased.

title: Battery warranty
body: Batteries are covered for 12 months; capacity below 80% within that period qualifies for replacement.

title: Accessory warranty
body: Accessories such as chargers and cables carry a 6-month warranty.

title: How a warranty claim works
body: A diagnostic is run first, then an RMA number is issued for the return.

title: Repair or replacement under warranty
body: We choose repair or replacement based on the fault; the customer cannot demand one over the other.

title: Order confirmation not received
body: Check spam and confirm the email address on the order; we can resend the confirmation.

title: Change items in an existing order
body: Items cannot be changed after an order is placed. Cancel before dispatch and reorder.

title: Cancel an order
body: Orders can be cancelled any time before dispatch, with no fee.

title: Order stuck on processing
body: Usually payment verification, which clears within 24 hours.

title: Backordered item
body: Backordered items ship when stock arrives; the rest of the order dispatches first.

title: When do pre-orders ship
body: Pre-orders dispatch on the product's release date, not at the time of ordering.

title: Order number format
body: Order numbers are formatted with a four-letter prefix followed by five digits.

title: Finding an order placed as a guest
body: Look it up with the order number plus the email address used at checkout.

title: Bulk or volume orders
body: The business team quotes volume pricing for large orders.

title: Gift wrapping
body: Gift wrapping is selected at checkout for a small fee.

title: Gift receipt
body: A gift receipt shows the items with no prices and can be added at checkout.

title: Adding an item to an existing order
body: Not supported. The customer must place a second order.

title: Item went out of stock after ordering
body: Offer a refund or the option to wait for restock; the customer decides.

title: Order placed twice by mistake
body: Cancel the duplicate before dispatch for an immediate full refund.

title: Corporate invoicing
body: Consolidated invoicing is available to approved business accounts.

title: Order shows complete but nothing arrived
body: Treat as a lost parcel and open a carrier investigation; do not close the ticket on system status alone.

title: Where to find product specifications
body: Full specifications are on the product page under the specifications tab.

title: Compatibility with other devices
body: Each product page lists verified compatible devices and required adapters.

title: What is included in the box
body: The box contents are listed on the product page above the specifications.

title: Power adapter and regional plugs
body: The adapter supplied matches the delivery region's plug type.

title: Product manual
body: Manuals are downloadable as PDF from the product page support section.

title: Checking stock availability
body: Stock levels shown on the product page update in real time.

title: When will an item be restocked
body: Restock dates are not guaranteed. Customers can request a notify-me alert.

title: Colour looks different from the photos
body: Screen rendering varies between displays. Genuine mismatches qualify as a change-of-mind return.

title: Refurbished versus new
body: Refurbished units are fully tested and carry the same 12-month warranty as new stock.

title: Product recall
body: Affected customers are contacted by email directly. Recalled items are replaced free of charge.

title: Energy rating information
body: Energy ratings and consumption figures are published on the product page.

title: Support for a discontinued product
body: Discontinued products are supported for 24 months after they leave the catalogue.

title: What customer data we store
body: We store account details, order history and tokenised payment references. Full card numbers are never stored.

title: Requesting a copy of my data
body: Data export requests are fulfilled within 30 days of verified request.

title: Deleting my data
body: Data is deleted on request except order records we are legally required to retain.

title: Marketing preferences
body: Customers can opt out of marketing at any time without affecting service messages.

title: Cookies on the site
body: Essential cookies are always active; analytics cookies require consent.

title: Data shared with delivery carriers
body: We share only the name, delivery address and phone number needed to complete delivery.

title: Reporting a phishing email
body: Ask the customer to forward it and not click any link. We never request passwords by email.

title: How card details are held
body: Card details are tokenised by the payment processor; we hold only the token and the last four digits.

title: Using more than one promo code
body: Only one promotional code can be applied per order.

title: Student discount
body: Student discount requires verification through our verification partner before it can be applied.

title: Price match policy
body: We match a lower price from an approved retailer within 14 days of purchase.

title: Loyalty points
body: Points accrue on every completed order and are redeemable against future purchases at checkout.

title: Referral programme
body: Referral credit is issued once the referred customer's first order has shipped.

title: Sale price adjustment
body: We offer 14-day price protection, so an item that drops in price within 14 days is refunded the difference.

title: Newsletter signup discount
body: The signup discount applies to a first order only and cannot be combined with other codes.

title: Expired promo code
body: Expired codes cannot be reinstated, though an equivalent active offer may be available.
